projects.title: 屏序 SyncWallpaper
projects.summary: 检测屏幕热插拔与布局变化，自动切换对应的壁纸方案。
projects.body: 为不同屏幕配置独立壁纸，并保存显示器布局对应的方案。支持秘境、极光科技、石墨暗色与云白亮色主题。
projects.summaryEn: Automatically switches wallpaper profiles when monitors are connected, disconnected or rearranged.
projects.bodyEn: Set individual wallpapers for each display and save profiles for different monitor layouts. Includes Mystic, Aurora Tech, Graphite Dark and Cloud White themes.

projects.title: 迪迦额度显示器
projects.summary: 用角色状态与仪表展示 Codex 和 Claude 的额度。
projects.body: 透明桌面挂件，提供条形与环形额度显示，角色随额度状态切换。页面中的数值仅用于交互演示。
projects.summaryEn: Displays Codex and Claude usage with character states and gauges.
projects.bodyEn: A transparent desktop widget with bar and ring gauges. The character changes with the remaining allowance. The values on this page are for demonstration.

projects.title: CSE 空间助手
projects.summary: 检查 UNSW CSE 账户的空间使用情况，并选择需要清理的项目。
projects.body: 通过 SSH 检查缓存、日志和旧版 VS Code Server 等占用；清理项目由使用者确认。这是个人项目。
projects.summaryEn: Checks storage usage in a UNSW CSE account and lets you select items to clean up.
projects.bodyEn: Uses SSH to inspect caches, logs and old VS Code Server files. The user confirms the items to remove. This is a personal project.

projects.title: SKY.无极输入法
projects.summary: 樱桃红与白色立体键盘，配合 Rime 中英文输入方案。
projects.body: 基于同文输入法 Trime 3.3.12 二次开发，集成雾凇拼音与离线说明。页面提供键盘外观与按键体验。
projects.summaryEn: A cherry-red and white keyboard with Rime Chinese and English input.
projects.bodyEn: A personal fork of Trime 3.3.12 with Rime Ice Pinyin and offline instructions. Try the keyboard appearance and keys on this page.

projects.title: 栖窗 Perch
projects.summary: 为窗口最小化与恢复添加可调节的过渡动画。
projects.body: 从 ZenDesktop 动画模块拆分，提供现代 Direct2D 与经典 GDI 效果，可调整动画时长。
projects.summaryEn: Adds adjustable transitions when windows are minimised and restored.
projects.bodyEn: Extracted from the ZenDesktop animation module, with modern Direct2D and classic GDI effects and adjustable animation duration.

projects.title: 说点啥 · Sky 无极君特供版
projects.summary: 红白键盘与语音波形界面，支持 FunASR 长语音分段。
projects.body: 基于 BryceWG/BiBiKeyboard v4.4.5 的个人修改版。这里使用示例文字演示交互，不采集麦克风声音。
projects.summaryEn: A red-and-white keyboard with a voice waveform interface and FunASR long-speech segmentation.
projects.bodyEn: A personal fork of BryceWG/BiBiKeyboard v4.4.5. This page demonstrates the interaction with sample text and does not record microphone audio.

projects.title: Sky 天 · 个人庄园
projects.summary: 在可探索的庄园大厅中阅读个人档案、作品和学习经历。
projects.body: 保留原版游戏场景与侦探走动，通过大厅入口进入不同页面；庄园主可在管理册中编辑与发布内容。
projects.summaryEn: Explore a manor hall to discover my profile, projects and studies.
projects.bodyEn: Uses the original game room and walking detective, with doorways into each part of the site. The owner can edit and publish content through the management journal.

recommendations.title: Office Tool Plus
recommendations.summary: 用于部署和管理 Microsoft Office，可自定义安装产品、语言与组件，并调整更新渠道。该 GitHub 仓库提供官方发行版本与本地化资源。
recommendations.usage:
1. 打开「部署」，选择要安装的 Office 产品和应用。
2. 添加需要的语言，确认架构与更新通道。
3. 导出安装配置，或确认配置后开始部署。
recommendations.summaryEn: A Microsoft Office deployment and management utility for selecting products, languages and components, and managing update channels. Its GitHub repository hosts official releases and localization resources.
recommendations.usageEn:
1. Open Deploy and choose the Office product and apps.
2. Add the languages you need, then check the architecture and update channel.
3. Export the configuration, or review it and start deployment.

recommendations.title: 7-Zip
recommendations.summary: 免费开源的文件压缩与解压工具，支持 7z、ZIP 等多种格式，提供图形界面和命令行工具。 macOS 与 Linux 提供命令行版本。
recommendations.usage:
1. 在文件管理器中选择要打包的文件或文件夹。
2. 点「添加」，选择 7z 或 ZIP 格式及压缩级别。
3. 确认生成压缩包；需要取出内容时选择「提取」。
平台说明：macOS 与 Linux 提供命令行版本；截图为 Windows 图形界面。
recommendations.summaryEn: A free, open-source file archiver supporting 7z, ZIP and many other formats, with graphical and command-line tools. The macOS and Linux versions are command-line tools.
recommendations.usageEn:
1. Select files or folders in the file manager.
2. Choose Add, then select 7z or ZIP and a compression level.
3. Create the archive; use Extract when you need its contents.
Platform note: macOS and Linux have command-line versions; the screenshot shows the Windows graphical interface.

recommendations.title: ShareX
recommendations.summary: Windows 截图、录屏与文件分享工具，支持区域捕捉、图像标注、GIF 录制和自定义上传流程。
recommendations.usage:
1. 选择「捕获 → 区域」，框选屏幕上的内容。
2. 在图像编辑器里添加箭头、文字或遮挡敏感区域。
3. 将截图保存到本地，或复制到剪贴板。
recommendations.summaryEn: A Windows screen capture, recording and sharing tool with region capture, image annotation, GIF recording and customizable upload workflows.
recommendations.usageEn:
1. Choose Capture → Region and select an area of the screen.
2. Use the image editor to add arrows or text, or obscure sensitive details.
3. Save the screenshot locally or copy it to the clipboard.

recommendations.title: Super Productivity
recommendations.summary: 将任务清单、时间记录和专注计时放在一起的效率工具，可规划每日安排，并接入 GitHub、GitLab 与 Jira 等任务来源。
recommendations.usage:
1. 在 Today 新建一项任务，并填写预计耗时。
2. 把任务安排到日程，启动该任务的计时。
3. 完成后勾选任务，在当天总结中回顾用时。
recommendations.summaryEn: A task manager combining to-do lists, time tracking and focus timers, with daily planning and integrations for GitHub, GitLab and Jira.
recommendations.usageEn:
1. Create a task in Today and give it a time estimate.
2. Schedule the task and start tracking time on it.
3. Mark it complete and review your time in the daily summary.

recommendations.title: HypoMux
recommendations.summary: Windows 多网卡聚合与分流工具，可让有线网络、Wi-Fi 和热点共同承担并发连接，并提供应用分流、连接监测和网络诊断。
recommendations.usage:
1. 连接两条可用网络，在首页勾选要使用的活动网卡。
2. 运行网络体检，选择系统代理或虚拟网卡模式。
3. 开启聚合引擎后开始多连接下载；用完后停止聚合。
recommendations.summaryEn: A Windows networking tool that distributes concurrent connections across Ethernet, Wi-Fi and hotspots, with application routing, connection monitoring and network diagnostics.
recommendations.usageEn:
1. Connect two available networks and select the active adapters on the home page.
2. Run the network check and choose system proxy or virtual adapter mode.
3. Start aggregation, then a multi-connection download; stop aggregation when finished.

recommendations.title: 洛雪音乐 · LX Music
recommendations.summary: 跨平台音乐查找与播放工具，提供播放列表管理、自定义音源和数据同步功能。
recommendations.usage:
1. 用搜索框查找歌曲或歌手。
2. 将歌曲加入自己的播放列表。
3. 配置可用且获授权的音源后，播放并查看歌词。
recommendations.summaryEn: A cross-platform music discovery and playback app with playlists, custom sources and data synchronization.
recommendations.usageEn:
1. Search for a song or artist.
2. Add tracks to your own playlist.
3. Configure an available, authorized source, then play music and view lyrics.

recommendations.title: Mineradio · 本地音乐版
recommendations.summary: 基于 Mineradio 与 Folia 的本地音乐播放器二创，支持音乐库管理、多格式音频、封面和桌面歌词。
recommendations.usage:
1. 点「导入文件夹」或「本地文件」，添加自己的音乐。
2. 双击歌曲播放，按艺术家、专辑或歌单整理音乐库。
3. 放入同名歌词或封面，切换歌词舞台或 Folia 视图。
recommendations.summaryEn: A local music player derived from Mineradio and Folia, with library management, multiple audio formats, cover art and desktop lyrics.
recommendations.usageEn:
1. Choose Import folder or Local files to add your own music.
2. Double-click a track to play and browse by artist, album or playlist.
3. Add matching lyric files or cover art, then switch to the lyric stage or Folia view.

recommendations.title: Mineradio · 原版
recommendations.summary: 结合粒子视觉、歌词舞台和 3D 歌单架的沉浸式音乐播放器；原项目目前长期停更。
recommendations.usage:
1. 进入音乐首页，打开音乐库或搜索歌曲。
2. 连接自己的音乐平台账号，选择可播放的歌曲或歌单。
3. 播放后切换歌词舞台、视觉预设或 3D 歌单架。
recommendations.summaryEn: An immersive music player combining particle visuals, a lyric stage and a 3D playlist shelf. The original project is currently on an extended hiatus.
recommendations.usageEn:
1. Enter the music home page and open the library or search for a track.
2. Connect your own music-service account and choose an available track or playlist.
3. While playing, switch between the lyric stage, visual presets and the 3D playlist shelf.

recommendations.title: Thunderbird
recommendations.summary: 开源桌面邮件客户端，在 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 上集中管理邮件、日历与联系人。
recommendations.usage:
1. 添加已有邮箱，按服务商提示完成登录。
2. 在文件夹列表中切换账户，阅读或撰写邮件。
3. 用搜索、标签和日历整理通信与待办事项。
recommendations.summaryEn: An open-source desktop app for managing email, calendars and contacts on Windows, macOS and Linux.
recommendations.usageEn:
1. Add an existing email account and follow your provider’s sign-in steps.
2. Switch accounts in the folder pane to read or compose messages.
3. Use search, tags and the calendar to organize messages and tasks.

recommendations.title: LibreTV
recommendations.summary: 可自行部署的视频聚合搜索与播放界面，支持多个数据源和观看进度记录。
recommendations.usage:
1. 打开自己部署的实例，输入访问密码。
2. 在设置中添加可用且有权访问的数据源，再搜索片名。
3. 选择搜索结果，在播放器中切换集数、调整倍速或续播。
recommendations.summaryEn: A self-hostable interface for aggregated video search and playback, supporting multiple sources and saved viewing progress.
recommendations.usageEn:
1. Open your own deployment and enter its access password.
2. Add an available source you are authorized to access in Settings, then search for a title.
3. Choose a result and use the player to select episodes, adjust speed or resume playback.

recommendations.title: Winhance
recommendations.summary: Windows 10 / 11 调整工具，集中管理系统应用、隐私与性能设置，并提供任务栏、开始菜单和资源管理器等个性化选项。
recommendations.usage:
1. 打开 Customize，找到任务栏、开始菜单或资源管理器选项。
2. 阅读设置说明，再调整所需的开关。
3. 检查效果，并导出配置以便以后恢复同一套设置。
recommendations.summaryEn: A Windows 10 and 11 customization utility for managing system apps, privacy and performance settings, with options for the taskbar, Start menu and File Explorer.
recommendations.usageEn:
1. Open Customize and find the taskbar, Start menu or File Explorer settings.
2. Read each setting’s description before changing the switches you need.
3. Check the result and export a configuration to reuse the same setup later.

recommendations.title: Bulk Crap Uninstaller
recommendations.summary: Windows 批量卸载工具，支持连续移除多个应用、识别遗留安装记录，并检查和清理卸载后的残留文件。
recommendations.usage:
1. 扫描已安装软件，在列表中搜索并勾选目标应用。
2. 开始卸载向导，核对程序清单和卸载方式。
3. 卸载后查看残留检查结果，只清理自己确认的项目。
recommendations.summaryEn: A bulk uninstaller for Windows that removes multiple applications, detects orphaned installations and checks for leftover files after uninstalling.
recommendations.usageEn:
1. Scan installed software, then search for and select the target apps.
2. Start the uninstall wizard and review the list and uninstall method.
3. Review the leftover scan afterward and remove only the items you confirm.

recommendations.title: CrystalDiskInfo
recommendations.summary: 硬盘健康监测工具，可查看 HDD、SSD 和受支持 NVMe 存储设备的 S.M.A.R.T. 信息、温度与运行状态。
recommendations.usage:
1. 打开程序，在上方选择要检查的硬盘。
2. 查看健康状态、温度和 S.M.A.R.T. 属性。
3. 在功能菜单设置自动刷新，或复制检测信息用于记录。
recommendations.summaryEn: A drive health monitor for viewing S.M.A.R.T. data, temperature and operating status on HDDs, SSDs and supported NVMe storage devices.
recommendations.usageEn:
1. Open the app and select the drive you want to inspect.
2. Read its health status, temperature and S.M.A.R.T. attributes.
3. Set an automatic refresh interval or copy the drive information for your records.

recommendations.title: CrystalDiskMark
recommendations.summary: 存储性能测试工具，通过顺序和随机读写测试，了解硬盘、固态硬盘及其他存储设备的读写表现。
recommendations.usage:
1. 选择测试次数、测试文件大小和目标盘。
2. 点击 All 运行整组读写测试，等待结果完成。
3. 比较顺序与随机读写结果；数值反映本次测试配置。
recommendations.summaryEn: A storage benchmark that measures sequential and random read/write performance on hard drives, SSDs and other storage devices.
recommendations.usageEn:
1. Select the number of runs, test-file size and target drive.
2. Click All to run the read/write tests and wait for completion.
3. Compare sequential and random results, which reflect this test configuration.
